notes: Albums you have in more than one format (for example FLAC and WAV) are now separate albums, each showing its format.

Back: after the first 3 seconds of a song it starts the song again; in the first 3 seconds it plays the song before. When the song was played from search, Infinity or Lyrion, Back now plays the song you heard before it.
History, a new button in the Queue: every song you played in the last month, on all your computers.
Show Path, when you right-click a song: shows where its file is.
A song that is twice in the same album shows a mark beside it; you can hide one copy. When an album has more than two, a Duplicates button hides all the extra copies at once.
The album picture's shadow in the full player now has the same rounded corners as the picture.
